bundles.rationale: The positive rule requires an explicit wrong assignment, meaning shift, conceptual conflation, or invalid inference; absent any defect cue, the default is none. Ambiguity is excluded because the speaker does not complain that analogical language changes meaning or confuses concepts.

This assertion about analogical language independently advances a narrower conceptual consideration, so the positive rule assigns the subsidiary tier when no central or motion bridge is advanced; the default excludes mere topic overlap. Central is excluded because no inference from patterns or purposive unities upward to Logos appears.
